raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This grouped bar chart illustrates the negative log probability values for the "Mistralv0.2-Base" model and its fine-tuned variants across six medical specialties, labeled along the horizontal axis as "Per-specialty terms": Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical axis, labeled "Negative log probability," is scaled linearly from -27 to -22. Each specialty group contains six bars, each representing a fine-tuned variant corresponding to a specific medical domain: Cardio (light beige), Gastro (light orange), Infect (orange), Neuro (dark orange), Obstetrics (brown), and Pediatrics (dark brown). The "Mistralv0.2-Base" model is represented by a single light blue bar in each group. Within each specialty, the bars are arranged side-by-side, with the "Mistralv0.2-Base" bar consistently positioned on the far left. The bars extend downward from the horizontal axis, indicating negative log probability values; the "Mistralv0.2-Base" bars are the tallest (most negative), while the fine-tuned bars are shorter (less negative). The chart does not show bars sorted in descending order; instead, the bars within each group are presented in the order specified by the legend, from left to right as Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics. There are no visual annotations or emphasis on individual bars beyond their color-coded representation.
